_comment: A tour is included if (tier >= min_tier OR name matches a keyword) AND it matches no exclude_keyword. Lichess tiers: 3 = normal, 4 = high, 5 = best.
_exclude_comment: Drops lower sections of a festival (Prague ships Masters + Challengers + Futures; only Masters is major) and age/rating-restricted fields. Deliberately does NOT exclude 'women' - the Women's World Championship is a major event.
_rounds_comment: Rounds whose name matches these are scheduling artifacts, not playing sessions.
_horizon_comment: Ignore rounds further out than this; schedules that far ahead churn.
_collapse_comment: Merge a tour's rounds that fall on the same UTC day into one event spanning first start to last end. Team leagues play several simultaneous matches per day; without this each playing day becomes 4 separate entries.
